name: Web2 – HTML to Elementor Converter
author: web2elementor

sections.description:
Web2 – HTML to Elementor Converter turns HTML code into native, editable Elementor pages. Paste the HTML your AI tool wrote, or upload your .html files, and get real Elementor containers, headings, text, images and buttons that you edit by clicking. Not an HTML widget, and no custom CSS.

Get Website Importer PRO | Prices | Support

What this plugin does

  • Whole sites, not one page at a time. Paste or upload several pages together and they are all set up in one go.
  • Your menu, built for you. The menu inside your pages links to your new WordPress pages, and it opens on phones too.
  • Header and footer as Elementor templates, for files from web2elementor.com: edit them once and they change on every page.
  • Elementor 4 or Elementor 3. Atomic elements or classic containers and widgets. No Elementor Pro needed.
  • Start in a minute. Sign in from the plugin screen and approve the code in your browser. No API key to copy and paste.
  • You see the price first. Nothing is charged before you confirm, and a page that cannot be converted is not charged.
  • Safe on a site that already has content. Your theme, your homepage and your menu stay as they are: your new pages are added alongside.

Who it is for

  • AI-built pages: the HTML an AI tool or an AI website builder gave you.
  • Static HTML sites and landing pages you want to edit visually in Elementor.
  • Agencies and freelancers who turn client mockups and HTML templates into Elementor pages.

How it works

  1. Open Web2 HTML to Elementor in your WordPress menu and sign in.
  2. Paste your HTML or upload your .html files (with their .css and .js if they came separately).
  3. Check the summary and the price, and confirm. Your pages open in Elementor, ready to edit.

Website Importer PRO: paste a URL, get the whole website

Paste a URL. That’s it. Website Importer PRO, from web2elementor.com, moves a whole website into WordPress. You give it an address; it does everything else.

Any published website, by its address

Site builders with no export included: you don’t need the code, a backup or access to the original site. Paste the address and Website Importer PRO reads the page as it looks in the browser.

The whole website in one go

Up to 15 pages at once. Each page keeps its own address, and your menu links them.

WordPress set up for you

It installs and activates Elementor and the Hello Elementor theme, sets your homepage and builds your menu. On a site that already has content, it only adds your pages.

Header and footer as Elementor templates

Edit them once and they change on every page, when the original site has them.

Real, editable Elementor pages

Headings, text, images, buttons and containers you edit by clicking, in Elementor 4 (atomic elements) or Elementor 3 (classic containers and widgets). Repeated styles become Elementor global classes, so you change them everywhere at once.

WordPress sites too

Move pages built with the block editor or with Elementor, by their address.

Your images, your choice

Leave them where they are, or download them all into your Media Library.

Paste and upload, too

Everything this plugin does: paste the HTML your AI tool made, or upload your .html files or a file from web2elementor.com.

No surprises

You see the price before anything is charged, and a page that cannot be converted is not charged.

Get Website Importer PRO · Prices: web2elementor.com/price

This plugin stays complete: nothing in it is locked or unlocked by Website Importer PRO.

How this plugin works

The conversion is done by the web2elementor.com service (see “External service” below). The plugin is the part that runs in your WordPress: it shows you what will happen and the price before anything is charged, and it creates your pages, templates and menu.

Web2 – HTML to Elementor Converter and web2elementor.com are an independent project, not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Elementor Ltd. “Elementor” is a trademark of Elementor Ltd. This plugin builds pages for Elementor.

What it costs

  • Everything in the plugin works the same for everyone: nothing in it is locked or unlocked by paying.
  • Converting and preparing your pages is done by the web2elementor.com service and uses credits from your web2elementor.com account.
  • The price is shown on screen before you confirm. Nothing is charged if a conversion fails, and the same content is not charged twice within 7 days.
  • Credits are bought on web2elementor.com, in your browser. The plugin does not sell anything and does not take payments: when your balance is not enough, it tells you so and links to web2elementor.com.

What this plugin changes

Nothing happens when you activate the plugin. Every change below happens only after you press a button, and the screen tells you what will happen before you confirm.

The plugin does not install, activate or update other plugins or themes, and does not change Elementor’s settings. Your pages need Elementor 3.35 or later (WordPress asks you to install and activate it before this plugin) and, on a fresh site, the Hello Elementor theme (both on WordPress.org). If the theme is missing or Elementor is older, the plugin shows a button that takes you to the WordPress screen where you install, activate or update it yourself; then press “Check again”.

Elementor 4.3 or later: when your file includes both versions, you choose: Elementor 4 (atomic elements, recommended) or Elementor 3 compatible (classic containers and widgets). If the Atomic Editor is off on your site (sites that were upgraded from Elementor 3), your pages are set up in the Elementor 3 format (this also needs Elementor’s Container feature) and the plugin links to Elementor → Settings → Atomic Editor, where you can turn it on yourself. Files that only have the Elementor 4 version need it on; nothing is charged until then.

Elementor 3.35 to 4.2: your pages are set up in the Elementor 3 format (classic containers and widgets). They need Elementor’s Container feature: if it is turned off on your site, the plugin tells you and links to Elementor → Settings → Features, where you turn it on. Files that only have the Elementor 4 version cannot be set up there: download them again from web2elementor.com, or update Elementor.

On a fresh WordPress (only the default content: “Hello world!”, “Sample Page” and the unpublished Privacy Policy, no static homepage, no menus, a default Twenty* or Hello theme):

  • creates your imported pages (Elementor Canvas template), and the header and footer templates when the page has them;
  • sets your imported home page as the site homepage (Settings → Reading);
  • builds the menu inside your imported pages so it links to them.

Existing demo content is not affected.

On a WordPress that already has content (your own pages or posts, a static homepage, a menu or another theme), the plugin shows a notice and works in a careful mode:

  • your theme is not changed and Hello Elementor is not needed;
  • your imported pages are added alongside your pages (Elementor Canvas template);
  • your homepage and Reading settings are not changed;
  • your site menu is not changed: the imported pages are listed in a separate menu called “Web2 HTML Importer”, not assigned to any location, that you can use if you want.

In both cases: if you import a page whose address already exists and was created by this plugin, that page is replaced in place (same page, same address). Pages created by you or by other plugins are never replaced or deleted.

We recommend a backup before making changes to an existing site.

External service

This plugin relies on web2elementor.com (web2elementor.com), an external paid service. It needs the service because the work is not done in WordPress:

  • Pasted HTML is converted by our conversion engine, which opens your page in a headless browser to read its real layout and turns it into Elementor elements.
  • An uploaded file (.json or .zip) is prepared for your site: the header and the footer are split into their own templates, the menu is rebuilt with the addresses of your WordPress pages, repeated styles are grouped into Elementor global classes when your Elementor supports them, and the format is adapted to your Elementor version.

What is sent, and when:

  • When you connect your account: you sign in or create an account on the web2elementor.com sign-in service (accounts.web2elementor.com / clerk.web2elementor.com, powered by Clerk). The plugin stores the access token in your WordPress database.
  • When you press “Continue” (a preview, not charged) and when you confirm a setup: the HTML you pasted (or the file you uploaded), the addresses and names you chose for your pages, the menus of the pages this plugin already created, your Elementor version, this plugin’s version, and whether your site already has content are sent to api.web2elementor.com, which converts and prepares the pages and returns them.
  • When the screen shows your balance: your credit balance is read from api.web2elementor.com.
  • If you choose “Download all images to my Media Library”: the images are downloaded from the addresses where they are hosted.

Nothing is sent before you connect your account, and nothing is sent in the background.

What the service keeps:

  • The HTML you paste is stored as a temporary page for 5 minutes while it is converted, and then deleted automatically.
  • A private copy of the HTML you paste, together with the Elementor file created from it, for up to 90 days. It is used only to find and fix conversion problems; it is never published, shared or sold, it is deleted automatically after 90 days, and you can ask us to delete it sooner (see the Privacy Policy).
  • Icons and images that are embedded in your HTML are saved as files on our servers, so that WordPress can download them into your site.
  • A fingerprint (SHA-256) of what you paste or upload, for 7 days, so that the same content is not charged twice. The fingerprint does not contain the content.
  • A record of each page set up (your site’s address and the page’s address), so that replacing a page is not charged again.

  • An entry in our logs for each conversion and each charge (your account, the date, the size and the credits), without the content of your pages.

  • Service: web2elementor.com

  • Terms of Service: web2elementor.com/terms-of-service.html
  • Privacy Policy: web2elementor.com/privacy-policy.html
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Elementor, which this plugin requires. On a fresh site, also install the Hello Elementor theme; the plugin links you to it.
  2. Install and activate this plugin.
  3. Open Web2 HTML to Elementor in the WordPress menu and sign in with your Google account or your email. It takes about a minute, and there is no API key to copy.
  4. Paste your HTML or upload your file, check the summary and the price, and confirm.
sections.faq:
Can I import a whole website at once?

Yes. Paste or upload several pages together and they are set up in one go, with your menu linking them. To import a website from its address instead of its code, see Website Importer PRO below.

Do I need Elementor Pro?

No. Your pages are built with Elementor’s own elements, in Elementor 4 or Elementor 3.

Will it change my existing site?

On a site that already has content, it does not change your theme, your pages, your homepage or your menu: it only adds the imported pages. We still recommend a backup first.

Does it cost money?

Converting and setting up pages uses credits from your web2elementor.com account. Get credits at web2elementor.com. The screen shows the price before you confirm. See “What it costs”.

Does it install Elementor for me?

No. The plugin never installs, activates or updates other plugins or themes. It shows you what is missing and takes you to the WordPress screen where you do it. If you want Elementor and the Hello theme installed for you, Website Importer PRO, from web2elementor.com, does it.

Can it import a website from its address?

This plugin imports the HTML you paste and the files you upload. To import a website from its URL (one page or the whole site, any published website, by its address: site builders with no export included), there is Website Importer PRO, from web2elementor.com: paste the URL and it does the rest.

What happens when I delete the plugin?

Deactivating the plugin removes nothing. Deleting it (Plugins → Deactivate → Delete) disconnects your web2elementor.com account and removes the plugin’s own settings and the files waiting to be set up. Your pages, their header and footer templates, the “Web2 HTML Importer” menu, your images and your homepage setting stay. Without the plugin, the header, the footer and the mobile menu it shows on the imported pages are no longer displayed; they come back if you install it again.
sections.changelog:
0.2.4

  • New name: Web2 – HTML to Elementor Converter.
  • The plugin screen presents Website Importer PRO, from web2elementor.com, which imports a website from its address. Close the card and it does not come back.

0.2.3

  • Asks for a review on WordPress.org after a successful import.
  • Upload a file now takes your .html files too, with their .css and .js.

0.2.2

  • New name: Web2 HTML Importer for Elementor.
  • The plugin only loads the WordPress admin file it uses.

0.2.1

  • Elementor 4.3 or later: when Elementor containers are turned off on your site, the Elementor 3 version is not offered (it needs them), and if your site can only use the Elementor 3 format, the plugin tells you and links to Elementor → Settings → Features.

0.2.0

  • Choose the Elementor version of your page: Elementor 4 (atomic elements, recommended) or Elementor 3 compatible (classic containers and widgets), when your file includes both.
  • Works with Elementor 3.35 to 4.2: your pages are set up in the Elementor 3 format. Elementor 4.3 or later is no longer required.
  • The plugin no longer changes Elementor’s settings: if the Atomic Editor or Elementor containers are off, it tells you and links to the Elementor screen where you turn them on.

0.1.2

  • The mobile ☰ menu of your pages now opens on phones in more layouts: a menu inside a header without a nav, a ☰ outside the nav, and Lovable sites. It no longer shows on a blue box.
  • A menu without a nav is recognised too: when you add a page called “About”, the “About” link of your menu opens it, and the summary says so.
  • On a site that already has content, your first page is added as a page, with its own address. Your homepage, theme and menu stay as they are.
  • Pages already on your site (the home page of a ZIP you imported before, for example) stay unchecked and are kept.
  • The button says “Add these N pages” when you add several pages.

0.1.1

  • Upload your .html files in the Paste HTML tab: one or several pages, with their .css or .js if they came separately. You can also drop them on the box.
  • With several files, the list of pages now says “Your files have N pages”.

0.1.0

  • First version.
